disputes.description: 0x004133B0/0x004134D0/0x00413600/0x00413710 share the same text-record copy pattern but hit distinct list accessors (0x00415680 vs 0x004156C0) and distinct offset tables; the shared pattern is a stated fact, not proof they share an owning type.

0x00404E60/0x00407450/0x00407520 all implement an append-with-cursor linked list, but use different header offsets (+0x40 vs +0x28 vs +0x38), different node sizes (8+12 vs 8+12 vs 116 bytes) and different keys (string vs string vs int); treated as three distinct list types until a shared constructor proves otherwise.

Audio slot packing is inconsistent across 0x00406130/0x004064C0 (reset loops advance by 0x14 bytes but field placement at +0x08/+0x0C/+0x10) and the 20-byte records in 0x004062B0; stride and the exact string-field width (+0x00..+0x07) are unresolved.

The packet mixes __thiscall constructors, __stdcall text helpers and one __fastcall path helper; the single schema signature field records only the primary entry 0x00411840 and is not a claim about the other 24 functions.

0x00414900 is __fastcall and the linked-list helpers are __thiscall while the text lookups are __stdcall; these are read from the raw C headers and are kept separate from the primary stdcall signature.

unresolved: StringCopyWithBufferRealloc / StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck / StringFormatWith0x40Size / MutexLockWithTimeout / VirtualCleanup / sub_588410 / sub_587DB0 / sub_58C724 / sub_587DD0 / sub_4080B0 / sub_406A70 / F_3DSoundEmitter (0x00456FB0) / BooleanToIntConversion / DecrementCounterWithFloorAtZero / ClampedFloatSetter are out-of-packet callees; their exact contracts are not proposed here.
byte_5EA438 is used throughout as an empty-string/default sentinel, but whether it is a mutable buffer or a shared read-only literal is not resolvable from the raw C alone.
sub_4FB6D0 (0x004FB6D0), the spatial distance helper called by 0x00403640, is outside the packet; the exact distance/radius transform (the '30.0' and '4.0' factors) is unverified.
vtable globals off_59E490 (0x004057F0), off_59E50C and off_59E4EC (0x00406130) are referenced but their contents are outside the packet.
0x00403640: stride 0x13C of the point array, the +0x12C per-entry flag semantics and the 'v22 <= 1' selection rule are stated as read from raw C but not runtime-verified.
0x004069F0: sub_58C724(handle, a3, 0) and the 0x8000-byte format buffer semantics are unresolved; the '9875/9876' and layout-context constants (397/426/1/2) in 0x00411B50/0x00411DB0 are opaque.
Character-map tables unk_5BEE08 / unk_5BF4C0 are indexed by char code but their element width and length are unknown; not committed to globals.
The session lookup path in 0x004122C0 depends on globals dword_7D0398/dword_7D0410/dword_8AC394 whose writers are outside the packet.
Thread requirement (game_thread vs any_thread) cannot be established from static evidence alone; requires runtime observation.
The shared emitter field block (+0x30..+0x60, +0x80..+0x90) is inferred from 0x00408870 writes; whether the same layout is consumed by 0x0040AA20's distinct 204-byte prefixed block is unproven.
